detected_language.description: BCP-47 code of the language the original letter was written in, e.g. 'de'.

sender.description: Who sent the letter (organization or authority name).

letter_type.description: Short category, e.g. 'vehicle registration notice', 'traffic fine questionnaire', 'promotional offer'.

requires_action.description: Whether the recipient must actually do something in response to this letter.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence plain-language explanation of what the letter is and why it was sent, written in the reader's chosen language.

date.description: Absolute date in YYYY-MM-DD if the letter states one; null if the deadline is relative or absent.

raw_text.description: The letter's own wording for the deadline, e.g. 'within one week of receipt'.

is_relative_to_receipt.description: True if the deadline is counted from when the reader receives or opens the letter, rather than a fixed calendar date.

consequences_if_missed.description: What the letter explicitly states will happen if no action is taken; null if not stated.
